incremental_key.description: Materialize only, incremental refresh only: an output column whose value only grows as rows arrive, such as a date, a datetime or an increasing number, instead of the proposed one. view-check-incremental lists the columns that qualify. Omit to keep the proposed key.

keep_materialized.description: Deprecate only: true to keep a materialized view refreshing after it is deprecated. By default, accepting a deprecate suggestion also stops the view's refreshes and deletes its stored table, unless other views or syncs depend on it.

lookback_seconds.description: Materialize only, incremental refresh only: how far before the last refresh's highest incremental_key value each refresh reads again, in seconds, so late rows are picked up. Omit to keep the proposed lookback.

refresh_interval_seconds.description: Materialize only: refresh interval to use instead of the proposed one, in seconds. Omit to keep the proposed interval.

refresh_mode.description:
Materialize only: incremental or full, instead of the proposed refresh_mode. Omit to keep the proposed one. Switching to incremental needs incremental_key and unique_key when the payload has none.

* `full` - Full
* `incremental` - Incremental

unique_key.description: Materialize only, incremental refresh only: output columns that identify a row, instead of the proposed ones. Must include every GROUP BY column. Omit to keep the proposed key.
